_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing short lines for ordering at a cafe

items.en: Can I have a coffee, please?
items.gloss_en: Could I get a coffee, please?
May I pay with a card?

items.en: Thank you, have a nice day.
items.gloss_en: Thank you, have a good day.

segments.text: Ordering at a cafe? Here are four easy lines. Repeat after me.
Can I have a coffee, please?
Thank you, have a nice day.

native.caption: 카페에서 영어로 주문하기가 떨리나요? 이 4문장을 저장해 두세요: “Can I have a coffee, please?”, “I would like it hot.”, “Can I pay by card?”, “Thank you, have a nice day.”. Ama 선생님의 발음을 듣고 멈춘 사이에 따라 해 보세요. Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해 보세요.

en.hook: Ordering at a cafe in English
en.caption: Nervous about ordering at a cafe in English? Save these 4 lines: “Can I have a coffee, please?”, “I would like it hot.”, “Can I pay by card?”, “Thank you, have a nice day.”. Listen to Ama, then say each one in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
